chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Rio de Janeiro, 2021. Copa América final: Argentina against Brazil. Rodrigo De Paul looks up, and sends a long pass over the defence. Di María runs onto it... and lifts it over the keeper. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. De Paul checks the space before the ball even reaches him. He opens his body, and hits it long with his right foot.

chapters.label: Over the top
chapters.text: The pass drops over Renan Lodi, right into Di María’s path. One touch, one chip over Ederson. Argentina win the Copa!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn, midfielders: look up early. If a runner is in space behind the defence, one long pass can find him.
